item.title: Texas is a blue state after 2026 midterms, at least for now
item.description: Democrats didn't just win the U.S. Senate and governor races in Texas. They won every statewide contest and will take control of the Texas House, making the state a blue one, at least for now.
item.content:encoded: Democrats didn't just win the U.S. Senate and governor races in Texas. They won every statewide contest and will take control of the Texas House, making the state a blue one, at least for now.
item.dc:creator: Ashley Lopez

item.title: A fiery end to a NASA mission that captured some of the universe's brightest events
item.description: NASA's Swift observatory is set to re-enter the atmosphere on Wednesday after two decades of gathering data.
item.content:encoded: NASA's Swift observatory is set to re-enter the atmosphere on Wednesday after two decades of gathering data.

item.title: Smokejumper flips Montana house seat held by GOP for three decades
item.description: Union leader and former wildland firefighter Sam Forstag has won a House seat in Montana that Republicans have held for three decades.

item.title: What's the future of the Democratic party in Texas, amid historic midterm wins?
item.description: NPR's Ailsa Chang talks with former Texas state Sen. Wendy Davis, a Democrat, about Texas flipping blue and what it means for future elections.

item.title: How well did polls predict the blue wave?
item.description: NPR's Mary Louise Kelly speaks with Anna Greenberg, a Democratic pollster, about what polls captured (and underestimated) after Democrats performed stronger than expected in midterm elections.

item.title: Another young Democratic Socialist mayor: David Morales wins in Providence, R.I.
item.description: At 28, Democratic Socialist David Morales is set to be Providence, R.I.'s new mayor. Like New York City's Zohran Mamdani, he's framed his campaign on affordability issues.

item.description: NPR's Ailsa Chang talks with Democrat Dr. Annie Andrews, who bested Republican candidate Darline Graham, the incumbent and sister of the late Sen. Lindsey Graham.

item.title: Some historic firsts from the 2026 midterm elections
item.description: Tuesday was not only a night of Democrat victories in midterm elections, but of historic firsts — including the first openly gay man elected to the Senate and the first Black woman elected governor.

item.title: Rahm Emanuel maps out a vision for what Democrats can achieve after taking Congress
